test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 19 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A train of length 282 m takes 12 seconds to pass over another train 248 m long coming from the opposite direction. If the speed of the first train is 68 km/hr, then find the speed of the second train.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = 282 + 248 = 530 m

Relative speed = 530 ÷ 12 ≈ 44.17 m/s

Convert first train speed: 68 km/hr = 18.89 m/s

Second train speed = 44.17 − 18.89 ≈ 25.28 m/s

**∴ Answer = 91 km/hr**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of first train = 282 m

Length of second train = 248 m

Time = 12 seconds

Speed of first train = 68 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Relative speed (opposite direction) = (sum of lengths) ÷ time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance = 282 + 248 = 530 m

⇒ Relative speed = 530 ÷ 12 ≈ 44.17 m/s

⇒ Convert 68 km/hr into m/s ⇒ 68 × 5/18 ≈ 18.89 m/s

⇒ Let speed of second train = v

⇒ Relative speed = 18.89 + v

⇒ 18.89 + v = 44.17

⇒ v ≈ 25.28 m/s

⇒ Convert into km/hr ⇒ 25.28 × 18/5 ≈ 91 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 91 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

Opposite direction ⇒ speeds are added.

Train Crossing Rule

Distance = sum of lengths when crossing.

Unit Conversion

km/hr to m/s ⇒ multiply by 5/18.
